yardsPerAttempt.label: Gross yards per pass attempt allowed

definitions.scope: Completed regular-season games only. Averages use available verified games; each bar shows its sample. Missing data is never zero.
definitions.pass: Gross passing yards exclude sack losses. Net passing yards subtract the magnitude of sack yards lost.
definitions.explosive: Explosive = a pass of 20+ yards or a rush of 10+ yards. Definitions chosen for this dashboard.
definitions.position: QB/RB/WR/TE allowance is the entire opposing position group per team-game, not an individual projection. RB includes FB.
definitions.fantasy: Offensive PPR: 1/catch, 1/10 rushing or receiving yards, 1/25 passing yards, 6/rush or receiving TD, 4/pass TD, -2/INT or offensive lost fumble, 2/two-point conversion. No return TDs, bonuses or defensive scoring.
definitions.league: League bar is a team-game weighted mean; percentages and yards per attempt use pooled attempts. Rank 1 is fewest allowed, or most sacks/takeaways.
definitions.points: Points against come from the final scoreboard and can include scores conceded by offense or special teams.
definitions.takeaways: Opponent interceptions thrown plus total fumbles lost, including special teams. QB hits are not a pressure rate.
